tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje dang dril bu'i rnam bshad bzhugs so// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zung 'jug bde chen rnam rol pa/ /he ru ka dpal la btud nas/ /thabs dang shes rab don mtshon pa'i/ /rdo rje dril bu'i rnam gzhag bri/ /spyir gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lam dang dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am gzhir gyur pa ni/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa yin la/ de'ang rgyud sde chen po bzhi la rang rang gi sngags sdom ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i thabs kyis dbang gi cho ga mi 'dra ba bzhi 'byung zhing / de dang rjes su 'brel bar dam tshig dang sdom pa'i bsrung tshul gyi rnam gzhag cung zad kyang mi 'dra ba rang 'byung ba las/ khyad par du rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i lugs kyi dam tshig mtha' dag kyang bsdu na/ gang zag lam gyi mtshams gyis dbang du byas nas/ las dang po'i dam tshig brtan pa cher thob pa'i dam tshig ste/ gsum du 'du bar bzhed do/ /de ltar gsum gyi dang po la/ bsrung bya'i dam tshig bza' ba'i dam tshig sgrub pa'am brten pa'i dam tshig mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig te/ bzhi las gzhan gsum ni/ rang gi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur la/ 'dir mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig bye brag tu bshad na/ spyir rgyud nas ji skad gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi bris sku/ glegs bam/ dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ ka pā la/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ka dgang gzar/ blugs gzar/ bgrang phreng / nā ro'i mi'i lpags pa chos gos/ stag gi sham thabs/ stag lpags sam ro ras kyi gdan/ rus pa'i rgyan drug sogs tshul bzhin du 'chang ba yin la/ de dag las kyang dam tshig gi rdo rje dril bu 'chang ba nyid gtso bor mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig tu gsungs pas/ de'i rnam par gzhag pa bstan pa la gnyis te/ mtshon bya don gyi rdo rje dril bu dang / mtshon byed brda'i rdo rje dril bu'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud las/ byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/

/shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thabs snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i byang chub kyi sems ni don gyi rdo rje dang / shes rab spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid ni don gyi dril bu ste/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i sgo nas/ nam du'ang mi 'bral bar spyod pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ brda'i rdor dril gyi rnam gzhag spyir bstan pa dang / dam tshig gi rdo rje dril bu khyad par du bshad pa gnyis kyi dang po la'ang / rdo rje dril bu'i rnam gzhag gnyis las/ dang po rdo rje la don bzhi ste/ dbye ba/ rgyu/ tshad dang / mtshan nyid bstan pa/ rnam dag gam/ de kho na nyid bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni spyir rdo rje la dbye na/ rtse dgu pa ye shes kyi rdo rje/ rtse lnga pa dam tshig gi rdo rje/ rtse gsum pa las kyi rdo rje/ rtse gcig pa klu rnams 'jigs pa'i rdo rje rwa gyes pa khro bo'i rdo rje/ gsang ba rgyan gyi rdo rje ste gnad kyi gsal byed las drug tu gsungs so/ /gnyis pa de dag gi rgyu ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i le'u sum cu rtsa gcig pa las/ gser sogs las ni brdungs dge ba'i/ /zhes gsungs te/ sogs khong nas/ dngul/ 'khar ba/ ljon dmar la sogs pa la'ang bya zhes pa'i don no/ /gsum pa tshad dang / mtshan nyid bstan pa la/ spyir rab 'bring gi tshad dang / cha so so'i tshad gnyis kyi dang po ni/ rgyud las sor chung tshad brgyad pa'am 'bring bcu drug gam/ rab nyi shu rtsa gnyis las lhag pa mi bya/ tshad las thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ zhes dang bzang po yongs bzung las/ sor brgyad nas tsam sor mo ni/ /nyi shu gnyis par grangs mnyam par bya/ ste tshad kha yar ba mi bya zhes pa'i don to/ zhes bshad pas tha ma chung tshad sor brgyad pa nas/ 'bring tshad sor bcu drug pa/ rab che tshad sor nyi shu rtsa gnyis bar du bya zhing / de bas lhag pa'i che ba mi rung la/

gzhan yang sor mo gnyis cha bskyed dbyi bya zhes 'byung bas/ sor brgyad nas nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du sor gnyis gnyis kyi 'phel 'grib shes par byas la/ sor brgyad/ bcu/ bcu gnyis/ bcu bzhi/ bcu drug bco brgyad/ nyi shu/ nyer gnyis kyi bar/ che chung rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa'ang rung bar bstan to/ /gnyis pa cha so so'i tshad saṃ bu ṭar/ cha gsum spyir rdo rje la bzung yod pa'i cha gcig ba'i gsum ste lte ba dang pad 'dab dang bcas par gsal zhing / /zhes dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gror sum cha gcig gsum par stsal/ zhes gsungs pas/ spyir rdo rje rab 'bring gi tshad gang yin kyang srid du cha gsum yod pa'i cha gcig bzung ba'i gnas te/ lte ba g.yas g.yon gyi pad+ma dang bcas pa/ cha gnyis g.yas kyi rwa rtsa nas rtse mo'i bar dang / de bzhin du g.yon gyi'ang ste/ de gsum cha mnyam por bya/ zhes pa'i don te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror spyir srid du cha gsum yod pa yi tshad kyi ni 'jal tshul/ dbus ste lte ba'i cha g.yas g.yon gyi rwa cha mnyam pa nyid dang srid du gang gyur pa/ /'di ni spyi yi zhes pa rdo rje thams cad kyi tshad yin te/ /zhes gsung pas so/ /de las kyang cha zhib tu phye na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ 'og 'og gi dbus rwa dang steng dang dbus kyi cha/ lte ba ste cha gsum po de nyid re re'ang gsum gsum ste/ /so so ru ni rnam gsum gsungs/ /zhes bshad pas/ gang gi cha gsum po de re re'ang gsum gsum dgos pa'i rdo rje'i steng du cha dgu yod pa ni dbus kyi dgu cha gcig ni lte ba'i tshad yin la/ dbyibs ni chos dbyings mtshon pas zlum por bya ba'am/ yang na mkha' 'gror dbus kyi cha yi tshad kyis ni/ lte bar yang dag gsungs pa yin/ margad rin chen lta bu ni/ /cha brgyad rab tu mdzes pa'o/ /zhes zur brgyad pa'i dbyibs su bya bar yang bshad do/

/de lta bu'i lte ba de'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su mu tig phreng ba'i ske rags res bskor ba byas te/ saṃ bu ṭar/ ske rags byas pa bzang po nyid/ /ces so/ /de'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su/ lte ba'i tshad dpangs su ldan pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad re'i steng du zla ba'i gdan te/ zla ba'i steng du cung zad phyir bskyed pa'i mu tig gi phreng ba res bskor ba/ zla ba mu khyud dang bcas pa'i rgya tshad ni/ rdo rje'i steng du gang yod pa'i sum gnyis thig skud kyis gzhal ba zlum por bkug pa la bya'o// zla ba dang mu tig phreng ba'i dpangs ni/ pad+ma drug cha ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ lte ba'i g.yas g.yon 'dab ma brgyad pa pad+ma'i steng du gnas pa ni zla ba/ /drug zla ba mu khyud dang bcas pa'i dpangs ni cha kun nas zlum po'o/ /zhes dang / bzang po yongs bzung las/ chu skyes 'dab brgyad mdzes pa yi/ pad+ma'i steng ste pad+ma'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi mu khyud dang de 'byung /mgo dang zhabs su zhes pa pad+ma'i rtsa ba dang lte ba'i tshigs su mu khyud ste de ltar na phreng ba gnyis/ /zhes dang / rwa brgyad rtsa ba'i yan lag zhes pa la rwa rnams kyi gdan tu/ /pad+ma kha phye ske rags mu tig phreng ba'i btags/ /dbus kyi cha zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las cung zad tsam/ /lhag par ske rags bya ba yin/ de phyir bskyed pa'i/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di dag ni rdo rje rnam grangs sngar smos pa thams cad yid kyi bshad pa'i spyir 'gro ba yin la/ bye brag tu rtse dgu pa ni/ mkha' 'gror/ pad+ma 'dab ma rnams gnas pa'i rwa rnams phyogs mtshams kyi chu srin kha nas byung dbus dang bcas pa'i rtse mo dgu ru bshad pa ni/ /ye shes kyi rdo rje ste 'gro ba phan yon sgrol/ rnams 'khor ba las/ /ces dang / saṃ bu ṭar/ chu srin kha las byung ba yis/ phyogs dbus kyi dang po bcas pa gdan rtse mo 'od zer zla bar gnas/

/rtse mo dgu pa rnam par bshad/ /ces gsungs pas phyogs mtshams brgyad dbus kyi rwa dang dgu yin la/ de dag gi dbyibs tshad kyang dbus rwa'i dpangs ni/ gong du bshad pa bzhin rdo rje'i gsum cha/ dbyibs zlum po brgyad gzhogs kyi rnam pa rtsa rtse cung zad phra zhing dkyil nas 'dra ba'i rnam pa ste/ mkha' 'gror/ rwa kun dbus kyi dkyil du gnas pa'i ni zlum rwa'i dbyibs pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pa dang blo dang ldan pa'i dbus ma cha brgyad pa'i/ ste brgyad gzhogs kyi rnam pa/ zhes dang / legs par bsdu ba las/ chos pa bzang po yongs su bzung ngo / /phyogs kyi cha las ma 'das pa'o/ zhes pa dbus rwa dkyil du thad kar gnas zhing phyogs su la yo ba/ /zhes gsungs so/ /phyogs mtshams kyi rwa rnams ni/ mkha' 'gror/ rtse mo kun gyis dbus ma zlum/ /phyogs sogs rtse mo 'dud pas gnas/ /zhes dang / cha gsum pa ni ces pa dbus rwa'am zad phyogs rwa'i rwa re re'i rtsa ba chu/ me'i bar cha gsum 'gos pa'i mtha'i rtse/ /cha gnyis nas bar dag gi bar dor ba rtse mo'i mtha' yin te mtha'i/ /rwa rnams kyi dbus su chud pa'i pad+ma'i 'dab mar gnas gang gsungs/ yin pa dbus te de las 'dud pa'i tshul kyi gnas pa/ /cha gcig chu srin kha yin te/ /zhes bshad pas/ g.yas g.yon gyi pad zla'i steng du rwa'i rtsa ba gsum cha chu srin gyi kha nas yod pa'i phyed khro ba'i nang du chud cing phyed ya 'gal ma 'gal gyi bar na gnas pa'i rtsa ba cung zad phyir bskyed pa/ dkyil gyi sum cha cung zad sbom pa/ thad ka'i cha la gnas shing / rtse mo'i cha gsum cha byin gyis phra bar song ba/ mche ba'i dbyibs ltar gug nas/ rwa dbus ma la 'byar zhing 'dud pa'i tshul du gnas pa yin la/ dbus rwa'i rtse ni phyogs rwa rnams 'dud pa'i sa nas/ nas phyed kyis gyen du 'phags te/

mkha' 'gror/ seng ge'i sna ru gyur lung 'di'i don grub chen bha wa bha dras mkha' 'gro'i 'grel pa seng ge'i sna zhes bya ba'i chu srin gyi sna'o/ /nas phyed tsam gyis bya ba ni rdo rje'i rwa las phyir 'phags pa'i chog mchan rnying pa las 'byung ba bzhin dbus rwa 'bru snon te bshad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs mod 'dir ni bshad bde bas/ pa 'di/ zhes pa'i seng ge'i sna gdong pa'i dkyil du 'byung ba ltar dbus rwa'i rwa kun gyi dkyil du 'byung ba'o/ /nas phyed tsam du mtho bar bya'o/ /zhes 'byung bas so/ /rgyud du/ rdo rje kun la blo ldan pas/ /mchu dang zheng ni mnyam por bya/ /zhes pa phyogs mtshams kyi rwa'i sbom pa nas thig skud kyis bskor ba dang / rdo rje'i srid mnyam por bya/ /zhes pa'i don yin gsungs so/ /gnyis pa dam tshig rdo rje ni/ 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur la/ gsum pa ni/ mkha' 'gror/ rtse gsum rwa gdengs por rnam 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin ma rungs par shes bya'o/ skrod par byed pa'i rdo rje/ /zhes gsungs te/ lte ba pad zla dang bcas pa'i dbyibs tshad gong bzhin la/ dbus rwa'i mdun rgyab gnyis bor nas g.yas gnyis su rwa dang bcas pa ste/ 'di la ma rungs pa skrod par byed pa'i rdo rje zhes kyang bya'o/ /legs bsdur/ zhi dang ma zhi bar dbye bas/ /yang ni las kyi rdo rje la rnam pa gnyis su brjod/ /bzhi pa sna tshogs rdo rje nyid/ zhes pas legs bsdur rtse dgu rtse lnga las kyi rdo rje rtse gsum pa zheng 'di la bltas pas bzhi pa yin pas/ phyogs re re la rtse mo lnga pa dang ldan gdong bzhi yin/ zhes rgya gram/ /ces las kyi rdo rje la gnyis su byas nas/ zhi rgyas sogs las sna tshogs sgrub pa la/ rtse mo lnga pa can gyi sna tshogs rdo rje dang / ma zhi ba ste/ drag po'i las sgrub pa la rtse gsum pa gdengs par 'byung bar bshad do/

/bzhi pa ni/ mkha' 'gror/ rdo rje rtse gcig par bshad pas/ klu rnams kun tu skrag par byed/ /ces gsungs pas/ mtshan nyid phal cher sngar bstan pa bzhin la/ phyogs rwa rnams dor nas dbus kyi rwa rnams gru bzhi pa nas gzugs lta bu te/ klu 'dul ba la khyad par du mnga' gsol/ lnga pa ni/ mkha' 'gror/ gdengs po rtse'i khro ba dang / lhag ma rtse gsum par bshad pa'i rjes su bstan pa'i khro bo'i ste 'dis gnon cing lha la sogs pa nges par gnon/ lha ma yin la sogs pa/ /zhes bshad pas/ khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'am/ rtse dgu pa gang yin kyang phyogs rwa rnams rwa dbus ma la ma reg par gdengs pa'i rnam pa can du bya'o/ /drug pa ni mkha' 'gror/ de nas gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis rgyan du btags par bya ba/ gsang ba yi/ rdo rje'i mtshan tshad dang bcas pa nyid yang dag parabashad/ kyis nyan cig pa'o/ /cha lnga pa yi sor mo'i tshad kyis ni/ /spyi gtsug rdo rje rab tu grags/ /cha drug gyur pa rna ba la'o/ /cha bzhi pa ni mgrin par ro/ /snying gar cha lnga pa nyid do/ /de bzhin cha drug gsang bar ro/ zhes pa skad pa nas mar 'phyang ba'o/ /lha mo lag par cha drug ste/ /ji ltar mdzes par brtag par bya/ /zhes gsang ba rgyan gyi rdo rje ste sna tshogs rdo rje'am/ gzhan rtse mo lnga pa'am/ gsum pa sogs pa'ang rung ste/ de dag gi tshad sor mo dbus ma'i tshigs la bskor ba'i tshad ni/ sor gsum yin la/ de lta bu'i sor gcig ni cha gcig yin cing / gzhan rnams des 'gres su shes par bya'o/ /de lta bu rnal 'byor pas rgyan du 'dogs pa'i dgos pa'ang don rtogs pa'i sgo nas ye shes 'phel ba'i phyir yin te/ mkha' 'gror/ rnal 'byor pa yis ye shes 'phel ba'i phyir/ /gsang ba rgyan gyi rdo rje yang dag gsungs/ /zhes 'byung bas so/ /bzhi pa rnam dag gam de kho na nyid bstan pa ni/

rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte ba zlum po ni/ de bzhin nyid/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng ma ni/ byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad/ 'og ma ni lcags kyu zhags pa la sogs lha mo brgyad dag pa'i ngo bo yin la/ pad+ma'i steng gi zla ba ni/ 'khor ba'i gdung ba sel bar byed pa'i brda/ rwa rnams chu srin gyi kha nas 'byung ba ni/ srid rtse'i sdug bsngal las 'dren pa'i mtshon byed yin zhing / steng gi dbus rwa ni/ rnam par snang mdzad dang / phyogs kyi rwa bzhi dang / mtshams kyi bzhi ni/ rigs bzhi dang / yum bzhi dang / 'og gi rwa dgu ni ye shes lnga dang / tshad med bzhi rnam par dag pa yin te/ mkha' 'gror/ ji ltar phyogs kyi rwa brgyad kyis dbus su sangs rgyas dgu pa'o/ /lha dgu la sogs rtse mo la'ang / /lha rnams dgu yi byin gyi brlabs/ /zhes dang / saṃ bu ṭa las/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad brgyad ste kyi dbus dang su ni/ /dgu pa la zhes gsungs pa dbus su ni sangs rgyas nyid/ rnam par snang mdzad/ de ltar rigs lnga dang yum bzhi ste/ lha dgu la sogs rtse mo ni/ /lha rnams dgu yis byin gyi brlabs/ /zhes gsung pa'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje dang / 'phrin las sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don byed pa mtshon zhing / gzhan rtse gsum pa sogs la/ dag pa ma bshad pas 'dir mi bri ste/ de dag ni rdo rje rnam par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni dril bu'i rnam par gzhag pa bstan pa la'ang / dbye ba/ rgyu/ tshad dang mtshan nyid bstan pa/ rnam dag de nyid bstan pa ni bzhi las/ dang po ni/ spyir dril bu la dbye na/ ye shes kyi dril bu/ dam tshig gi dril bu/ tshe ring ba dang nad med par byed pa'i dril bu/ dpa' bo'i dril bu/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dril bu ste lnga'o/ /gnyis pa de dag gi rgyu ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ dril bu thams cad kyi khog pa'i rgyu ni kho na la byas pas tshang mgo'i rgyu ni/ 'khar ba lcags gsum skyes/ de gser dang dngul zangs lcags/

/zhes dang / legs bsdur/ de yi cha bzhi 'khar ba yis/ /rang bzhin ma 'dres pa la bya/ /zhes bshad pas/ de'ang khog pa'i rgyu ni/ gzhan ma 'dres pa/ 'khar ba'i rang bzhin kho na la byas pa/ dbu rtse ni/ gong du lcags gsum zhes bshad pas/ gser dngul zangs gsum gang yang rung ba dang / ljon dmar sogs rgyu gzhan la'ang rung ste/ legs bsdur/ khog pa las gzhan pa'i tshang mgo'o/ gzhan ni rgyu gzhan la rtag yin/ /zhes bshad pas so/ /gsum pa la/ spyir rab 'bring gi tshad bstan pa dang / cha so so'i tshad bstan pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ sor brgyad nas nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi bar gang yang rung ba rdo rje'i tshad rjes su bstan pa bzhin 'dir yang yin te/ mkha' 'gror/ cha gsum mtshan nyid dang ni ldan/ /zhes dang / brgyad nas bcu drug bar dang ni/ /nyi shu gnyis lhag bya ba min/ /ji ltar rdo rje'i tshad dang rjes mthun par/ /sgrub pa'i dbang pos bya ba yin/ /zhes dang / legs bsdur/ de ltar sor brgyad la sogs pa'i/ /dril bu rdo rje'i rjes mthun sbyar/ /zhes sogs/ gnyis pa ni/ mkha' 'gror/ dril bu cha gsum ldan pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dril bu kha dang kha nas steng du bcal ba dang / dbu dang sum cha mnyam por bya/ /zhes pa'i don yin la/ bzang po yongs bzung las/ dril bu ngos kyi cha drug la/ ste srid du zhes pa'i don/ /de'i cha bzhi 'khar ba yis/ /zhes dril bu la srid du cha drug byas pa'i sum gnyis khog pa dang / sum cha dbu rtse la bya bar bshad de/ rgyud nas gsung pa dang gnyis gang thad byas pas chog par mngon no/ /dbyibs sam mtshan nyid ni/ mkha' 'gror/ kha phub pa dbyibs/ pad+ma rgyas pa ltar byung ba'o/ /zhes pa'i don/ khog pa'i mgo zhabs 'tshams pa la/ /ba lang mchu zhes bya ba la/ /mchu 'thug sa phyir bskyed pa las/ /slar yang nang du cung zad rubs pa/ /pad+ma kha bye ba lta bu'o/ /de'ang legs bsdur/ cung zad chu skyes kha phye ba'i/

/khar gyur gang yin ba glang mchu/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i logs kyi dbu zhabs gnyis la mu tig phreng ba nyis bsgrigs re'i bar/ 'og tu 'phred dang steng ma la kyus su bsgrigs pa'i rdo rje'i phreng ba bya zhing / de gnyis kyi bar rdo rje'i phreng ba gong ma las 'phyang ba'i tshul gyis/ drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa byas te/ mkha' 'gror/ rdo rje'i khog pa'i steng 'og tu phreng ba/ ste de re re la'ang /ske rags gnyis dang shel ltar snang zhing dri med pa'i/ ldan pa dang gnyis kyi bar du dag pa'i/ /drwa ba drwa ba phyed pas brgyan/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /khog pa de'i steng gi dbu rten gyi mthar/ ut+pal la'am/ ku mu ta'i dbyibs kha bcu drug gyes pa'i phyi rol/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du lha mo brgyad kyi sa bon bkod de/ de'i shar taṃ/ lhor laṃ/ nub tu maṃ/ byang du paṃ/ shar lhor baṃ yig gam suṃ yig lho nub tu tsuṃ/ nub byang du kraṃ/ byang shar du maṃ gyi yi ge rnams mgo phyir bstan pa bya'o/ /de'ang / mkha' 'gror/ phyogs brgyad du ni lha mo ni/ /brgyad po'i ming can grags pa yin/ /de yi steng gyur sa bon las/ /lha mo brgyad po bsam par bya/ /shar du lha mo sgrol ma ste/ /de bzhin byang du gos dkar mo/ /nub tu mā ma ki zhes dang / /lho ru sangs rgyas spyan ma la'o/ /mdog nor 'dzin ma bzang mngar rtsub dang ma 'od can dang / khro gnyer can/ /rin chen rdo rje phreng ba ma 'khyil pa rnams kyis brgyan/ /zhes 'byung ba'i don yin la/ dbu rten de nyid kyis steng du ji ltar bya ba na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ khog pa'i steng gi pad+ma kha bye ba lta bu las byung ba'i/ dbus/ /gzugs med srid 'chab pa pa'i gnas khog pa'i steng dbu bsten gyi su ni/ /shes rab bum pa'i bdud rtsi lta/ /de lta bu ye shes bdud rtsi'i gsang ba'i bum pa'i gnas su ni/

/de yi yang ni dbus su yid/ te chos nyid kyi rtsa ba yid shes sbyong ba/ /lha mo shes rab pha rol phyin/ ma'i zhal yongs su rdzogs par bya zhing / /steng gi pad+ma rdo rje ni/ /snga ma rdo rje bzhin du bsam par bya/ /zhes dang / legs bsdur/ steng dang dbus su rim ji bzhin/ /ut+pa la yi steng gi cha/ dbu rten/ steng gi gnas su phreng ba gsum/ rim pa/ bum pa'i rgyud/ /gser dang zangs las bum pa'i rnam pa bya ba'i/ /yang na dngul gyi bum pa bya/ /de steng bum pa de yi tshad tsam la/ /shar du shes rab gdong pa bya/ /gdong steng sngon gyi rdo rje phyed/ /rdo rje phyed pa nyid ni bya/ /zhes bshad pas/ gser zangs sogs rgyu las grub pa'i phreng ba rim pa gsum phyir bskyed pad+ma phye ba lta bu'i steng du bdud rtsi bum pa'i lte bar gnas gnas shing / de'i steng du lha mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i zhal shar gyi taṃ yig la gzigs pa'i steng / pad+ma zla ba'i steng du rdo rje rtse dgu sogs rang rang gi dbu rtses mtshan pa'o/ /gzhan yang / saṃ bu ṭa las/ nang gi gzugs ni nam mkha' ste/ zhes gzugs med mtshon pa'i khog de'i steng du/ gzugs bum pa'i rdzogs de lta bu'i zhal sogs mtshan nyid kun yon tan thams cad 'byung pa'i gnas su gyur pa'o/ /zhes dang / mkha' 'gror/ nam mkha'i phyogs kyi dbus su ni/ /gzugs rdzogs yon tan rnams kyi gzhi/ /zhes pa'i don dbu rten gyi rtser/ phreng ba gsum gyis bskor ba'i steng du bum pa dang / lha mo'i zhal rdzogs pa la bzhed do/ /khog pa de'i dbus su ji ltar mtshams pa'i lce lcags sam khro las grub pa'i sgra 'byin pa'i phyir/ nang gi nam mkha' rdo rje la btags par bya ste/ mkha' 'gror/ dbus khog pa'i su ye shes dbyug pa rtse ni/ lha /thams cad 'phro zhing dbang du sdud par byed/

/ces dang / saṃ bu ṭar/ khog nang gi ye shes dbyig dgu ni/ /lha thams cad dbang du sdud cing sgra 'byin par byed/ pa'i dgos pa'o/ /ces gsungs so/ /de dag gi don kyang lce des dril bu'i khog pa la bskul ba'i stobs kyis/ lha thams cad dbang du sdud cing / sgra sna tshogs 'byin par byed ces pa'o/ /de dag ni dril bu thams cad kyi phyag tshad dang mtshan nyid yin la/ bye brag tu ye shes kyi dril bu ni/ mkha' 'gror/ khog stong sgra ni zab pa ste/ /dga' ba kun gyi ro ni 'dzin/ /ut+pal ku mu ta nyid dang / /rin chen pad+mas nye bar brgyan/ /zhes dang / ye shes dang zung du rdo rjer gyur pa'i dril bu/ ni/ /rtse mo rdo rje ltar dgu pa de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pas/ khog pa'i logs kyi drwa ba'i dkyil rnams su/ shar du ku mu ta/ lhor rin chen/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ut+pal la rnams kyis spras shing / gzhan sngar bstan pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa'i dbu rdo rje phyed pa rtse dgu pas brgyan pa'o/ /de nyid kyi dgos pa'ang / mkha' 'gror/ zhi rgyas sogs/ las rnams thams cad sgrub par byed cing / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i/ /dngos grub kyi mchog ni ster bar byed/ /ces gsungs pas shes so/ /gnyis pa dam tshig gi dril bu ni/ 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur la/ gsum pa ni/ mkha' 'gror/ sor mo srid du bcu gnyis tshad kyis tsam la/ khog pa'i logs la'ang / /rdo rje phreng ba ske rags can/ /khog pa'i dbyibs/ dbang po mchog gi 'dab ma ste pad+ma dang mtshungs pa yang / /drwa ba drwa ba phyed pas brgyan/ /mdor na sngon bzhin mtshan thams cad nyid dang ldan/ /khyad par lha mo'i mtshan ma rnams kyis spras/ pa ste/ /shar du gnas pa'i pad+ma ni/ /kha dog dkar po rab mdzes pa'o/

/re lhor khu byug gi sgro byung rtsa ba sngo skye bas des mtshon pas ut+pal li/ gshin rjer khu byug sgro sngon por/ /nub tu 'dam skyes dmar po ste/ /ljang khu byang du de bzhin ut+pal byin/ /steng gi bdud rtsi gnas kyis dbus su ni/ /zhal gcig pa ni dbus su gnas/ zhal de nyid gang gi yin na/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lha mo 'i zhal de'ang / /gzugs mdzes shing bzang la yon tan rnams kyi gzhi 'o/ /steng du pad+ma rdo rje/ /sngon bzhin du ni bsam par bya/ /dbus kyi ye shes dbyig pa 'i khyad par ni/ /cha brgyad kyis ni rnam par spras/ /zhes tshad sngar bstan pa bzhin sor bcu gnyis pa khog pa'i logs la pad+ma dang / ut+pal sogs kyi mtshan ma bkod cing dbyig pa ste/ lce brgyad gzhogs kyi rnam par bya'o/ /de lta bu bshad pa'i rnal 'byor pas bcang pa'i dgos pa'ang / mkha' 'gror/ lha mo chen mo zhes zhu ba po la bos nas dril bu 'di yin te/ /sgrub pa tshe ring zhing nad med pa longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /de bzhin du shes rab ldan par gyur zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ mkha' 'gror/ rdo rje phreng ba dang ske rags bum pa bzang / pa sogs/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rab tu rdzogs par bya mod kyi 'on kyang / /drwa ba dang drwa phyed pa'i mtshan ma spang / de mi bya'o/ /de'i srid du sor mo dgu yi tshad stsal la/ /de yi kha ni zheng ni sor lnga yis/ /tshad las lhag par mi bya'o/ /dbu rtse ni rtse lnga pa dang rtse dgu pa/ gang rung ste/ /dpa' bo'i dril bur rdo rje 'dzin pas yang dag gsungs/ /zhes bshad pas/ gzhan sngar gyi mtshan nyid bzhin la/ 'on kyang drwa ba drwa phyed spangs pas/

tshad srid du sor dgu pa'i/ /kha la sor lnga'i tshad dang ldan zhing / rtse lnga'am rtse dgu gang rung gis spras pa'o/ /'di la rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dril bu zhes kyang bshad do/ /de lta bu bzung ba'i phan yon kyang / bskal bzang po kun dang dbang phyug dang / /sngags kun gyi ni 'bras bu ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun gyi sngags pa de la rdzu 'phrul stobs/ /phun tshogs la sogs de rab dge ba dang legs pa thams cad rab tu stsol/ bar mdzod/ mdor na /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi dngos grub ni/ /bzang po mchog tu gyur ba rnams ni rab tu stsol/ /zhes bsngags pa rgya cher gsungs so/ /lnga pa de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dril bu ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rnams kyi/ /dril bu'i mtshan nyid rab tu bshad/ khog pa /mkhar ba'i rang bzhin la byed las sgra snyan par byed/ /khong stong bum pas brgyan pa ste/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /ral dri la sogs mtshan mar ldan/ /drwa ba drwa ba phyed brgyan zhing / /rwa rnams chu srin kha nas 'byung / /ye shes lnga yi rnam dag pa/ /rtse mo lnga ni mdo ru bsdu/ /zhes mdor bstan nas/ de nyid rgyas par bshad pa/ phreng ba gnyis dang / ske rags gnyis kyi dbus su ni/ /rnam snang gi dril bu la 'khor lo'i phreng ba gnyis dang ldan/ /de bzhin ske rags gnyis dbus su/ /'od dpag med la/ pad+ma'i phreng ba gnyis dang ldan/ /sngar bzhin byas pa las khyad par bum pa'i gdan te rin 'byung la/ rin chen dbang gi phreng ba gnyis dang rin chen ldan/ /de bzhin du yang ske rags te/ /dril bu la don yod ral grir 'di phreng ba bshad pa ni/ /de bzhin ske rags gnyis dbus su/ /zhes dang / de ltar /rdo rje rigs sogs kyi dril bu ba glang la kha/

/rdo rje phreng ba ske rags sogs dang ldan/ /rab tu mdzes pa'i kha khyer gru bzhi pa/ byang zhing / /steng du bum pa yang dag gnas/ /zhes 'byung bas bum pa'i gdan gru bzhi pa'i dbyibs dang / dbu la rdo rje phyed pa rtse lnga pa kho na la bya zhing / gzhan gong gi mtshan nyid ji lta bu la khog pa'i logs kyi dbu zhabs su rdo rje'i phreng ba gnyis yod pa'i bar rnam snang gi 'khor lo la dril bu dang / de bzhin du rin chen rigs kyi dril bu la rin po che'i phreng ba gnyis gnyis bya ba sogs sam/ rdo rje'i ske rags kyi dod la rang rang gi rigs dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rigs so so'i mtshan ma'i ske rags gnyis gnyis bya bar yang rung zhes bshad do/ /de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i dril bu mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bzung ba'i phan yon kyang / ba glang kha la sogs pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dril bu bcangs pas ru/ /rin chen sogs nor chen gzhan yang 'bru yi tshogs ni 'bad med 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dus rtag tu nad med cing stobs dang mdangs ni ster/ par byed/ nad gdon sogs sdug bsngal kun sgrib pa'i dang dri ma ma lus par sel/ /ces gsungs so/ /bzhi pa rnams dag gi de kho na nyid ni/ legs bsdur/ khog pa'i nang na gnas pa'i nam mkha' stong pa ni/ /gzugs med pa'i khams rnam par dag par byed pa'o/ /gzugs khams rnam par dag pa mtshon byed 'di/ dbu rten gyi rtsa bar gnas pa'i/ ut+pal rtsa ba kha phye ba/ lta bu sogs dang gzhan yang / /shes rab bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gnas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i gzhi/ /steng gi chu skyes rdo rje ni/ /rdo rje lta bur rnam par bsam/ ste 'di rnams la sbyar ro/ /zhes bshad pas/ sbyang gzhi khams gsum dang / sbyong byed sku gsum gyi mtshon byed du sbyar na/

nang gi nam mkha' gzugs med dang chos sku/ khog pa'i lha dang mtshan ma la sogs pa sna tshogs su snang ba sprul sku dang 'dod khams/ bum pa yan chad gzugs khams dang longs sku rnam par dag pa yin la/ cung zad rgyas par 'og tu 'chad do/ /de ltar spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa sngon du song nas/ da ni don gyi gtso bo dam tshig gi rdo rje dril bu bye brag tu bshad par bya ste/ de la'ang mtshan nyid dang / de kho na nyid bshad pa dang / de kho na nyid ma shes pa'i nyes dmigs dang / de nyid shes pas ji ltar bzung ba'i tshul chog dang bcas pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po la'ang gnyis kyi/ dam tshig rdo rje mtshan nyid/ rgyu dang dbyibs tshad la sogs pa'i rnam par gzhag pa phal che ba ni/ gong du bstan pa bzhin yin te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror/ rnal 'byor pas mi 'bral pa'i/ de nas dam tshig du bzung bar bya ba'i rdo rje yis/ tshad dang /mtshan nyid yang dag par bshad par bya/ /gser sogs pas brdungs pa'i rdo rje yis/ /sa bon gyi cha'ang de bzhin cha gsum sogs gong du gsungs pa ltar ste/ /sngon rdo rje ske rags bzhin mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing / /pad+ma zla ba rnam par gnas/ /chu srin so yi rnam pa yi/ /rtsa ba chu srin kha las byung / /zhes gsungs pas shes la/ khyad par du rwa'i grangs ni/ gang yang sbom du gyur pa yi/ /rwa ni ye shes rang bzhin gsungs/ /zhes 'byung bas/ ye shes lnga'i grangs dang mthun par/ rtse lnga pa kho nar bya zhing / dbus rwa'i dbyibs ni/ gru bzhi pa nas gzugs lta bu bya'o/ /saṃ bu ṭa las kyang / ye shes rdo rje la 'gro ba 'don/ /zhes pa ye shes lnga dag pa'i rtse lnga pa can gyi dam tshig rdo rje de kho na nyid shes pas bcangs na/ 'khor bar 'gro ba las 'don pa'i don te/ 'dis dam tshig gi rdo rje bstan/ /ces man ngag gi bshad pa las gsungs so/ /gnyis pa dam tshig gi dril bu'i mtshan nyid ni/

rgyud gnyis las/ dngos bstan gsal bar ma gsung kyang / gnad gzhir sbyor ba'i gdan gyi rab tu byed pa dang por/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i mtshan nyid gsungs nas/ de ma thag dril bu'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i skabs su/ steng du rdo rje pad+mo dag /ji ltar sngon bzhin bsam par bya/ /zhes rdo rje phyed pa rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i dril bu bshad pas bstan la/ de'i dbyibs/ tshad/ rgyu la sogs pa spyir bstan pa'i gnas skabs bzhin las khyad par du/ rdo rje'i phreng ba gnyis kyi bar drwa phyed dam 'khor lo'i phreng ba gang rung bya zhing / dbu rtse ni rdo rje phyed pa rtse lnga pa'i dbyibs su bya'o/ /gnyis pa de kho na nyid las/ dang po rdo rje'i rnam gzhag ni/ sbyang gzhi'i dbang du byas na/ steng 'og rā lnga pa ni nyon mongs pa lnga dang / phung po lnga dang / lte ba zlum pos ni de dag gi chos nyid dang bcas pa sbyong la/ sbyong byed kyi dbang du byas nas/ rgyud las/ lha ni nyi shu rtsa bdun ldan/ steng 'og gi rwa lnga la lha lnga lnga ste bcu/ steng 'og gi pad+ma bcu drug ste nyi shu rtsa drug lte ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum ste/ de ltar nyi shu bdun no/ /'di la man ngag tu lte ba'i yab yum so sor bgrang nas rtsa brgyad du byed pa'ang 'byung ngo / /zhes gsung zhing / /de'ang zhib tu phye na/ dbus su ye shes sems dpa' ni/ /zhes pas/ lte bar rdo rje sems dpa'/ steng gi rwa lnga ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa ste/ mkha' 'gror/ kun gyi dbus su rnam snang mdzad/ /shar du mi bskyod pa nyid de/ /lho yi rwa las rin chen 'byung / /nub tu 'od dpag med pa dgod/ /byang du don yod grub pa ste/ /rwa bzhi la sogs sa yi lha/ /zhes so/ /'og gi rwa lnga ni/ lha mo lnga yi ngo bo ste/ dbus dang shar la sogs pa yi/ /rwa bzhir mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'god/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/

/byang du 'jigs ma zhes bya ba/ /nub tu ro langs ma ni gnas/ /lho ru gtum mo gnas pa ste/ /dbus su ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /dam tshig rdo rje can bsgom bya/ /zhes gsungs la/ lte ba'i cha la brten la steng gi pad 'dab brgyad ni/ byang chub kyi lam yan lag brgyad mtshon zhing / sems dpa' brgyad kyi rang bzhin du dag pas te/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad byang chub yan lag gi ngo bo dag cing / de /ji lta ba bzhin gyi gnas su bzhag pa de bskor bar bya ba/ /pad+ma'i phyag spyan ras gzigs dang byams pa dang / /nam mkha' mdzod dang kun tu bzang / /gnod sbyin bdag po phyag rdor 'jam pa'i dpal/ /sgrib pa sel dang nam snying dang / /'di yi lha ni brgyad po rnams/ /ji bzhin 'dab mar brtag par bya/ /zhes dang / 'og gi 'dab ma brgyad ni/ pad+mar lha mo brgyad gang yin/ /ji bzhin gnas su sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa ma/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog dril bu ma/ /lha mo bzhi po 'di dag ni/ /phyogs kyi 'dab mar rnam par gnas/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi po la/ /lha mo bzhi po de ltar yang / /skul byed rin chen sgron lha mo/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud ces dang / /de bzhin gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /thams cad 'dab mar dgod par bya/ /zhes lha mo brgyad kyi ngo bor rnam par dag cing / gzhan yang pad+ma 'dab brgyad ni shes rab dang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni thabs kyis mtshon byed yin pas/ thabs shes zung 'jug gi mu khyud dang chu srin gyi mgo bo 'khor ba'i mtshon byed/ rwa rnams ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtshon byed yin la/ mdor na mtshon byed rdo rje 'dis mtshon pa'i/ mtshon bya sbyang gzhi rnams ni 'khor ba/ sbyong byed lha rnams ni mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ de gnyis phan tshun rgyu 'bras ro gcig tu rtogs pa'am/ rang gi sems kyi dbyings gcig nyid du shes pa ni/

'khor 'das byer med ces bya ba/ de kho na nyid mthar thug pa ste/ 'di ni kho bos legs par bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa dril bu'i de kho na nyid la/ sgra'i de kho na nyid dang / gzugs kyi de kho na nyid bstan pa gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ saṃ bu ṭa las/ shes rab dkrol ba'i de nyid ni/ /lha rnams kun gyis thos par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa/ shes rab ni stong pa 'di yin la/ dkrol ba ni de'i don mtshon par byed pa/ dril bu'i sgra ste/ sgra des chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / mngon par 'dus ma byas pa dang / rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ston par byed pa'o/ /de'i dgos pa'ang / saṃ bu ṭa las/ nam mkha'i khams kyi mthar thug par/ /byang chub snying por rnam par gnas/ /phyogs bcu thams cad rigs pa'i gnas/ /'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas pa/ /zhes gsung ste/ de lta bu'i dril bu'i sgra des/ phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthar thug par dus byang chub snying po'i bar du stong pa nyid brjod par byed pa'i sgras khyab par bsam zhing / de nyid kyis sems can gyi khams mtha' yas pa ma rig pa'i gnyid las sad par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ saṃ bu ṭa las/ phyogs ni brgyad ces bya ba ni/ /lha mo brgyad ni rab tu grags/ /yi ge brgyad kyi sa bon ni/ /phyogs ni brgyad du rnam par 'god/ /shar du lha mo sgron ma ste/ /zhes sogs dang / khog pa'i nang gi gzugs ni nam mkha' ste/ gzugs med mtshon la/ /gzugs kyi gang ba gzi brjid can/ ni lha'i zhal sogs te gzugs khams mtshon/ /pad+ma dbyibs kha phye ba lta bu las byung ba/ /gzugs med pa mtshon srid pa'i khog pa dbu rten dang bcas pa'i gnas su ni/ /shes rab bdud rtsi bum pa lta/ /ye shes bdud rtsi gnas su ni/ /de yi dbus su yid kyi ni/ /lha mo shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gzigs na mdzes shing yon tan gnas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ nang gi nam mkha' stong pa gzugs med kyi khams dang chos sku/

khog pa'i lha dang mtshan ma la sogs pa sprul sku 'dod khams/ bum pa dang lha mo'i zhal ni gzugs khams dang longs sku yin la/ rdo rje phyed pa ni de lta bu'i sbyang gzhi khams gsum dang / sbyong byed sku gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i don no/ /yang khog pa kho na dang / sku gsum mtshon byed du sbyar nas/ nang gi khog pa stong pa ni chos sku/ de nyid la ye shes kyi dbyig pa gnas brgyad du bskyod pa sprul sku/ gsung rnam dag 'byung ba longs sku'o/ /gzhan yang lha dang sbyar ba ni/ khog pa'i steng gi sa bon brgyad/ lha mo brgyad/ steng gi lha'i zhal ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma rnam par dag pa yin la/ gzhan pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang / rdo rje phyed pa ni/ gong du bstan pa ltar/ byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad dang / rigs lnga'i ngo bo dag pa ste/ saṃ bu ṭa las/ steng gi pad+ma rdo rje rnams/ /ji ltar gong bzhin bsam par bya/ /zhes 'byung bas so/ /'di la 'khor 'das bsre tshul gong bzhin shes par bya ste/ dril bu'i de kho na nyid do/ /gsum pa de kho na nyid ma shes pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ sngar bstan ma thag pa de nyid rnams mi shes kyang / rdo rje dril bu bcangs pa las phan yon yod dam snyam na ma yin te/ saṃ bu ṭa'i brtag pa bzhi'i rab byed gnyis pa las/ rdo rje dril bu'i de nyid/ med cing mi shes pa rnams kyis bcangs na/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub de nyid skye bar mi 'gyur te/ /ces dang / brgyad pa'i dang po las/ de nyid med kyang sngags par sems pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /glang po che'i dril bu 'khrol ba dang mtshungs nyid/ /rnal 'byor de nyid sman pa yi/ /rang gi dngos grub ring du brtag /ces gsungs shing / mkhas pa smṛ tis kyang / rdo rje'i de nyid mi shes pas/ /brgya byin lag gi mtshon cha bzhin/ /zhes bshad pas/ de kho na nyid mi shes pa'i rnam 'byor pas rdo rje dril bu bcang yang /

phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub las mi rings te/ dper na brgya byin gyi rdo rje'i/ /rta dang glang po'i mgul rgyan gyi dril bu bzhin no/ /bzhi pa de nyid shes pas ji ltar bzung ba'i tshul cho ga dang bcas pa bstan pa la/ de nyid shes pa'i phan yon byin brlabs bya ba'i tshul/ blang ba'i cho ga dkrol ba'i grangs dang bcas pa bstan pa/ mi 'bral bar bzung ba'i thabs phan yon dang bcas pa bstan/ mi 'bral bar bzung ba'i thabs so/ /dang po ni/ saṃ bu ṭa'i brgyad pa'i dang po las/ thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa'i chos kyis de nyid shes pa rnams gyis ni/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi 'gro ba dang po ma rig pa las sad par byed/ /mi shes 'dam du bying ba yi/ /sems can sangs rgyas don du bkrol/ /ces pa ltar de nyid shes pas bcangs zhing dkrol ba'i stobs kyis/ 'gro ba rnams rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi dang po ma rig pa'i gnyis las sad par byed pa dang / mi shes pas 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying bas sems can rnams sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngar ji ltar bshad pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje dril bu mngon par 'dus byas te/ rang nyid kyi mdun du stegs bu la sogs pa'i gzhi la/ rdo rje g.yas dang / dril bu g.yon du rnal 'byor pa rang la ltos pa'i g.yas g.yon su shes dgos go ma nor bar bzhag rgyun gyi tshe dril bu'i zhal rdo rje'i lte ba la blta bar bshad kyang / skabs 'dir dgos rab gnas dus su dmigs pa bde phyir pa'i dbang gis rang la bstan par bya/ 'byor na mchod pa lnga'ang bsham/ de nas rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas bgegs sbyang sdig pa rnam pa gsum dri ma sbyang ba ni gyis sbyangs/ ma grub na bgegs bskrad pa dag bkru ba tsam bya/ de nas swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang rdo rje dril bu so sor mi bskyod par bskyed/

de dag zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje dang dril bu/ rang rang gi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur ba'i rdo rje tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i lte bar rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum/ steng gi rwa lnga la dbus su rnam par snang mdzad/ shar du mi bskyod pa/ lhor rin 'byung / nub tu 'od pag med/ byang du don yod grub pa rwa'i 'og gi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la shar du spyan ras gzigs/ lhor byams pa/ nub tu nam mkha' mdzod/ byang du kun du bzang po/ byang shar du phyag na rdo rje/ shar lhor 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ lho nub tu sgrib pa rnam sel/ nub byang du sa'i snying po/ 'og gi 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ lhor zhags pa ma/ nub tu lcags sgrog ma/ byang du dril bu ma/ byang shar du skul byed ma/ shar lhor rin chen glog lho nub tu lu gu rgyud ma/ nub byang du gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ 'og gi rwa lnga la/ dbus su ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ lhor gtum mo/ nub tu ro langs ma/ byang du 'jigs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ dril bu 'khar ba la sogs las grub pa tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum pa shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma yab yum dang bcas pa khog pa'i steng du/ ut+pal gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la/ lha mo sgrol ma/ lhor spyan ma/ nub tu mā ma ki/ byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du nor rgyun ma/ shar lhor tsun da/ lho nub tu khro gnyer can/ nub byang du rdo rje phreng ba ma/ steng gi 'dab ma brgyad la/ sems dpa' brgyad dang / rwa lnga la rigs lnga sngar bzhin bsgom/ thams cad kyang rgyan cha lugs sku mdog dang bcas pa re re nas gsal gdab mi dgos yongs su rdzogs par lam gyis bltas la/ gnas gsum byin gyi rlabs ye shes pa spyan drangs pas rgyas bsdus gang rung byas te bstim/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag po rdo rje sems dpa' rgyas gdab/

mchod bstod spyan dbye byas ma/ brtan bzhugs dang shis pa brjod pa sogs kyang rgyas par bya ste/ de dag ni byin gyi brlabs pa'i cho ga'o/ /gsum pa ni/ saṃ bu ṭa'i brgyad pa'i dang po las/ rang gi 'dod pa'i lha ste yi dam gang yin par ni bsam par bya/ /zhes dang / thabs lag g.yas dang shes rab lag g.yon pa'i dngos/ /g.yas pa la nyi ma yang rdo rje dang bcas pa dag pa bsam/ /g.yon pa yang ni zla ba pad+ma nyid/ dang bcas pa/ /ces sogs dang / de ltar byin gyi brlabs pa sngon du song nas/ rang lhar gsal ba'i lag pa g.yas pa/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ lte ba la nyi steng hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ g.yon pa āḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa lte bar zla ba la as mtshan pa/ de gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i lag par bltas pa/ de nas/ saṃ bu ṭar/ de la lag gnyis rab tu skyong / /rnam par 'dod pa lnga'i bskor bar bya/ /zhes bshad pas ngag du hūm̐ āḥzhes brjod cing / rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba bya/ de'i rjes su/ saṃ bu ṭar/ ā li kā li dgos pa ni/ /zhes ā li kā li ni thabs shes te dpe mthe bong thabs dang / srin lag shes rab gnyis bstan pas/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong dang / srin lag gis rdo rje blangs te/ ngag tu/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas hūm̐ lan gsum brjod pa dang bcas la/ rgyud nas/ byang du zhes pa'i don/ g.yas pa las g.yon du cung zad phyogs te snying ga nas smin mtshams gyi bar du lan gsum gsor bas/ sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes bar mos/ mthar snying gar gzung ste/ thog mtha' med pa'i byang chub kyi ngo bo zhes de kho na nyid dran pa de ltar yang / saṃ bu ṭa las/ byang du rdo rje gsor nas ni/ /hūm̐ gi glu yi rnam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes par bya/ /rdo rje gsor ba mdzes pa yis/ /rmongs pa'i sems can rnam par sgrol/ /chos kyi rnam thar 'bras bu nyid/

/rdo rje dgyes pa 'dzin pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /yang g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang / srin lag gis dril bu blangs zhing / oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe a/ zhes pas/ dkur bkan te bzung la/ srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa ston par byed pa/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i ngo bo nyid ces dran par bya/ de nas dharma ra ṇi ta'i sngags brjod cing / dril bu phyogs kun tu bskor zhing nang gi khog pa'i lce phyogs mtshams brgyad du bskyod nas dkrol te/ saṃ bu ṭar/ rdo rje gsol ba de'i phyi nas blo dang ldan pas yang dag par dkrol/ tshul/ /gnas ni brgyad du bskyod par bya/ /zhes so/ /de ltar gnas brgyad du bskyod pa'i dgos pa'ang phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te bdag rgyud byin gyi rlobs par 'gyur ba dang / nang du snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad bskul bas/ bde chen gyi ye shes skye ba'i phyir yin gsung ngo / /de dag kyang bsdu na/ rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gi dril bu gsung gi dam tshig gi rang nyid lhar gsal ba lha sku phyag rgya'i dam tshig gi ste/ mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig gi skabs su/ rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang / /zhes pa'i don kyang 'di nyid yin la/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig las logs su gyur pa gzhan med pa'i phyir/ rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len gyi gnad thams cad kyang / rnam pa gcig tu na 'dir 'dus par rtogs so/ /bzhi pa mi 'bral bar bzung ba'i thabs phan yon dang bcas pa bstan pa ni/ de ltar tshul bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ dam tshig gi rdo rje dril bu de nyid/ dus nam du'ang mi 'bral bar 'chang zhing / dkyil 'khor chen por ma smin pa'i gang zag dag la ni/ nyam nga'i 'phrang du yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang ldan pa gzhan la bstan na 'grog rgyu dgos pa ltar rnams kyi rang gi dngos grub yal du song pa'i bsam pa kun tu sba zhing ma bstan la/

skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag dbang gi smin pa'i gang zag 'ga' tsam la bstan par bya ste/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis las/ gal te skal med mthong na ni/ /skye ba 'dir ni dngos grub med/ /yang dag rab sbyin ldan pa la/ /cung zad tsam zhig bstan pa nyid/ /ces so/ /'o na dus nam du'ang 'phral bar mi bya na/ dgos pa khyad par can gyi tshe/ ci zhig bya zhe na 'di la bla ma'i gsung gis/ nyan thos dag tu rlom byed pa'i/ /nang du zhag bdun gnas pa dang / /zhes gsungs pa'i rig pas gzhan don rgya chen por gyur ba sogs dgos pa khyad par can nges par mthong ba'i tshe/ zhag drug 'bral du gnang la/ zhag bdun pa'i tho rangs kyi tshe ltung bar 'gyur zhing / dgos med du zhag gcig bral na'ang / ltung bar 'gyur gsungs so/ /mdor na mi 'bral ba sogs dam tshig dang sdom pa dran shes bzhin gyis legs par bsrung zhing bskyangs pas/ dam tshig gnas la mkha' 'gro ma/ /rang bzhin gnas kyang byin gyis rlob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams ring nas 'du zhing byin gyis rlobs pa dang / mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong srung ma bran bzhin bsgo ba nyan la/ gzhan yang / dam tshig rab bsrungs bsod nams kyis/ /tshe 'di nyid dngos grub ma lus pa la 'grub par 'gyur/ /ces bla ma dang yi dam mnyes pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu 'grub par 'gyur ba nyid do/ /rgyud sde'i pad tshal bla ma'i gsung zer gyis/ /legs phye bdag blo'i bung bas gzhibs pa las/ /rnam par bshad pa sbrang rtsi'i bcud 'di byung / /don gnyer skye bo'i tshogs rnams dga' bar gyis/ /mkhas pa gzhan gyis byas pas dga' mthong mod/ /phal cher rgyud sde'i don la phyi rol gyur/ /legs sbyar 'di ni rgyud don kho na las/ /gzhan min de phyir kun gyis blang bar rigs/ /legs par bsam kyang nyes pa mchis srid na/ /bla ma lhar bcas kun gyis bzod mdzad cing /

/dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma mus pa/ /mthar thug bde chen 'grub pa'i rgyu gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ gdan bzhi/ dpal saṃ bu ṭa'i/ rdo rje dril bu'i rnam gzhag ston pa'i skabs rnams dang / khyad par rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa'i saṃ bu ṭa'i dka' gnad kyi gsal byed gzhir bzhag nas/ rje btsun gong ma'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ a wa ti pa'i btsun pa 'khon gyi rigs can go don gyis mchan bu 'di rnams kyang / las dang po dag la phan pa'i phyir/ blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos smin drug zla'i nyer gnyis kyi nyin/ rgyud tshig rnams la sngon gyi tshig gzhir bzhag cing / cung zad go dka' ba dag gsal bar byas te/ rtsom pa po rang nyid kyis bris pa dge legs 'phel/ kha'u skyed lhas kyi dgon par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni kun dga' bsam grub kyi bgyis so// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 8 kun dga' blo gros/ rdo rje dang dril bu'i rnam bshad/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 9
